# Sundae

> Sundae is a decision intelligence platform for closed-loop profit recovery in multi-location food-service operations.

Sundae helps operators recover preventable profit loss across every location. It finds where profit is slipping, helps the right person act, and measures what changed. Its operating loop is: detect, decide, execute, measure, learn.

Sundae does not claim to remove macroeconomic pressures such as wage increases, taxes, rates, or commodity inflation. It helps teams distinguish controllable operational losses, route accountable action, and measure whether margin was protected or recovered.

## Decision intelligence products

Sundae connects live operations, forecasting, external context, cross-domain analysis, benchmarking, accountable execution, and outcome measurement. Each product below has a distinct role in that operating system.

- [Sundae Core](https://www.sundae.io/core): Decision workspace for evidence, priorities, accountable action, and measured outcomes
- [Pulse](https://www.sundae.io/product/pulse): Real-time restaurant operations, shift exceptions, action tracking, and operational coaching
- [Benchmarking](https://www.sundae.io/product/benchmarking): Anonymized peer context and location comparison across restaurant operating metrics
- [Foresight](https://www.sundae.io/product/foresight): Restaurant demand forecasting, predictive planning, and scenario modelling
- [Watchtower](https://www.sundae.io/product/watchtower): Competitor, local event, weather, and market intelligence for restaurant operators
- [Insights](https://www.sundae.io/product/insights): Cross-domain restaurant analytics across revenue, labour, inventory, purchasing, marketing, reservations, delivery, guests, and profit
- [Cross-Intelligence](https://www.sundae.io/product/cross-intelligence): Connected analysis of relationships between operational signals that are normally reviewed in isolation
- [Ask Sundae](https://www.sundae.io/product/intelligence): Natural-language questions and evidence-based answers across connected restaurant data
- [Profit Recovery](https://www.sundae.io/product/recovery): Governed detect, decide, execute, measure, and learn workflow for preventable profit loss

- [Integrations](https://www.sundae.io/integrations): Connection and data-health approach for POS, labour, inventory, purchasing, reservations, delivery, and other operating systems

## Workforce operations for hospitality

Sundae Crew connects workforce execution to the same decision-intelligence layer used for restaurant and hospitality performance. It covers scheduling, time and attendance, people and HR records, payroll readiness, employee self-service, and workforce intelligence. Customers can use Crew directly or connect an existing HR or payroll provider.

- [Crew overview](https://www.sundae.io/crew): Workforce operations, HR, payroll readiness, and employee self-service
- [Staff scheduling](https://www.sundae.io/crew/scheduling): Demand-aware scheduling, availability, shift swaps, and approvals
- [Time and attendance](https://www.sundae.io/crew/time-attendance): Mobile clock-in, break records, verification, and payroll-ready hours
- [Payroll](https://www.sundae.io/crew/payroll): Multi-country payroll calculation, review, statutory outputs, and provider handoff
- [People and HR](https://www.sundae.io/crew/people): Recruiting, onboarding, employee records, documents, reviews, leave, and offboarding
- [Workforce intelligence](https://www.sundae.io/crew/people-intelligence): Workforce health, no-show risk, overtime, and labor cost alongside sales and demand
- [Hospitality operators](https://www.sundae.io/solutions/hospitality-operators): Operating intelligence across hospitality F&B outlets and revenue streams
- [HR and people teams](https://www.sundae.io/solutions/hr-teams): Labor visibility and accountable workforce action by shift
